Connect a client once, then ask it about your Klang content in plain language. No copying transcripts around: the client signs in with OAuth, or you hand it an API key. What you can do The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI clients call tools on a remote server. Klang's server turns your workspace into a set of read tools the assistant can reach for on its own. Once connected, prompts like these work against your real data: forum Summarize what we decided about pricing across last week’s calls. forum Which customers brought up SSO this month? forum Find the interview where the claimant gave the accident date and quote it. forum List the open action items from every meeting in my onboarding folder. The assistant lists your conversations, opens the relevant ones, and reads their transcripts and summaries to answer. It works the same in a case workflow, where you point it at a specific folder, and across a busy meeting workspace, where you let it find the threads for you. Server URL The server speaks Streamable HTTP at a single endpoint. For Klang Cloud that is: https://app.klang.ai/api/mcp Self-hosted and dedicated-tenant deployments use a different host. Open Settings → Developers → MCP in your Klang workspace to see and copy your exact URL. Point any compliant MCP client at that URL and it handles the rest. See connecting clients for per-client setup. Write access is per connection A connection only reaches the one workspace it is bound to. Write access is decided per connection: Create and edit access is ticked by default on the consent screen when connecting with OAuth and when creating an API key; untick it for a read-only connection. With write access an assistant can also manage todos, tags and folders, rename or move conversations, and start transcriptions from a URL, a local file or a meeting bot. It still cannot delete conversations or share anything. See write tools . Errors Every failed call sets isError and returns {"error": {"type", "message"}} . type is one of validation (arguments rejected before the tool ran; the message names the field), bad_request , unauthorized , forbidden , not_found , conflict , rate_limited , plan_upgrade_required , integration_not_connected or internal_error . Some errors add a finer code (for example tag_name_taken ) or extra fields such as upgrade_url or connect_url . Pagination cursors are bound to the tool that issued them. zh.summary: 把组织对话变成可搜索、可定期分析的共同记忆。
zh.judgment: 价值在跨会谈形成可追溯线索；单次转写准确并不足以证明组织知识有效。
zh.replaces: 团队分别保存会议录音、整理摘要，再手工比对多次客户和内部讨论。
zh.product: 官网提供转写、摘要、搜索与定时跨对话分析，支持 API 和 MCP；Pianissimo 是另一个语音模型对象，不能把模型测速当作整个平台效率。
zh.customer: 领导、销售、客户和会议密集团队有明确用途。采购者需要看到跨会谈的信息复用与权限治理，而不是多保存一份纪要。
zh.workflow: 产品页描述接入会谈、设定分析主题与周期，再把结果送到 Slack、邮件或工作区。跨会议推断要能追到原始发言，避免将不同场合拼成错误结论。
zh.business_model: 价目列出免费层，Pro 每人每月 17.5 欧元，页面同时注明 12 个月承诺；Team 询价并提供部署及治理选项。账期切换与实际合同需另核，不能把显示价当作任意月付价。
zh.traction: 本次核验到功能、价目与文档，没有取得具名客户的独立效果对照。宣传中的模型速度与平台留存、跨团队采用是不同证据。
zh.moat: 多会谈的连接、机构词表和权限范围可能有价值。会议助手与企业搜索都是替代；只有跨对话分析能减少决策准备，而不是增加摘要阅读量，才形成持续性。
zh.funding_read: 资金支持从转写到知识流程拓展，下一里程碑可看第二个团队复用和定期分析的持续阅读。数据保留、部署及客户成功成本也需计入扩张。
zh.risks: 转写错误可能传播到后续分析，过宽权限可能泄露会议内容。定期摘要若无法溯源，可能让管理者根据片面模式下判断。
zh.takeaway: 让每条跨会谈发现带出处、时间与适用范围。把组织记忆接到实际决策节奏，减少重复寻找和阅读。
zh.watch_next: 看跨团队复用、分析被采纳比例、溯源纠错率和每机构支持成本。按语言和会谈类型评估，而不是用单一语音模型测试代替产品验证。

en.summary: Organizational conversation memory with search and scheduled cross-meeting analysis.
en.judgment: Traceable reuse across conversations matters more than transcription accuracy alone.
en.replaces: Keeping recordings and summaries separately, then manually comparing discussions.
en.product: The site offers transcription, summaries, search, scheduled analysis, API and MCP. Pianissimo is a distinct speech model; its benchmark does not establish platform-wide productivity.
en.customer: Leadership, sales, customer and meeting-heavy teams have clear use cases. Buyers need information reuse and permissions rather than another saved meeting note.
en.workflow: The described flow connects conversations, sets topics and cadence, then sends analysis to Slack, email or a workspace. Findings need original speech references to avoid combining incompatible contexts.
en.business_model: The page lists Free and Pro at €17.5/person/month alongside a 12-month commitment; Team is quoted with governance and deployment options. Billing toggles and actual terms require confirmation.
en.traction: Features, pricing and documentation were reviewed, without independent named-customer outcomes. Speech-model speed is distinct from retention and cross-team adoption.
en.moat: Conversation links, institutional vocabulary and permission boundaries could differentiate it from meeting assistants and enterprise search. Analysis should reduce preparation instead of adding reading.
en.funding_read: Capital supports expansion from transcription into knowledge workflows. Repeat scheduled use and adoption by a second team are milestones; retention and customer-support costs affect expansion.
en.risks: Transcription errors can propagate and broad permissions can expose content. Untraceable scheduled summaries may encourage decisions based on incomplete patterns.
en.takeaway: Attach source, time and scope to cross-conversation findings. Fit memory into actual decision cadence to reduce repeated search and reading.
en.watch_next: Watch team reuse, acted-on findings, corrections and institutional support cost by language and meeting type. One speech benchmark is insufficient product validation.
